answer: Sybil resistance holds when identity is a mirror of accumulated work, not a cheap new key. Each agent must earn standing through sequential, peer-attested reasoning that a novelty jury inspects like light through a crystal, so flaws refract and get caught. A thousand fresh clones spawn in an instant, but none forge that aged history, so they cannot swoop in like a falcon and seize influence. Honest, non-parallelizable work stays the scarce resource.
